question: Where can I get a list of thermal and nuclear power plants in Germany, with location, fuel or technology, capacity (MW), operator, status and annual generation?

answer.summary: Germany’s Bundesnetzagentur publishes the Kraftwerksliste for units at sites of at least 10 MW, with fuel, gross and net capacity, operator and status. SMARD provides site coordinates and publishes annual net generation for units of at least 100 MW. MaStR is the underlying unit register. No nuclear unit remains in operation.
main_caveats: Do not count reserves as operation: 1,488 thermal units (incl. biomass) 'InBetrieb', 57,399 MW net, vs about 14.7 GW in grid/capacity reserve, KVBG phase-out or temporary closure; MaStR shows such units as 'In Betrieb'.

Kraftwerksliste reports the Bundesland without coordinates. In the MaStR export tested, coordinates, municipality and postcode were absent for sampled units of at least 10 MW. SMARD provides one point per site.
SMARD reports annual MWh from 100 MW. ENTSO-E reports average MW per interval and requires a token. This review found no per-unit generation figures for smaller CHP and industrial units.
Bases differ: Kraftwerksliste gross and net MW, MaStR kW, UBA gross MW, ENTSO-E net MW; LEAG plant totals run 3.5-4.6% above ENTSO-E-based sums without stating gross or net.
All 9 nuclear rows in the Kraftwerksliste are 'endgültig stillgelegt' (2015-2023); historical nuclear generation per unit is in Energy-Charts nuclear_unit files.
answer.confidence_reason: Kraftwerksliste, SMARD metadata, MaStR export and JSON, UBA list and Energy-Charts files were downloaded and counted; SMARD unit series match Energy-Charts within 0.5%; the ENTSO-E API (token) was not queried.

attributes.note: SMARD gives one coordinate pair per site. The availability of coordinates, postcode and municipality in MaStR varies by unit.
Per unit: Energietraeger, Hauptbrennstoff, Technologie (Kraftwerksliste); further fuels in MaStR (WeitereBrennstoffe); fuel mixes as text in UBA.
Kraftwerksliste: Bruttoleistung_MW and Nettonennleistung_MW per unit; MaStR the same in kW; SMARD net MW; UBA gross only.
Anlagenbetreiber per unit (blank only for permanently closed units); MaStR operator id ABR... and name; SMARD company per site.
Kraftwerksstatus separates InBetrieb, grid/capacity reserve, KVBG phase-out, temporary and permanent closure; MaStR has only 4 states.
SMARD reports annual MWh for units from 100 MW. Some operators publish plant totals. Generation per unit below that threshold was not found in the sources checked.
attributes.gap_note: No per-unit annual generation found for units < 100 MW: MaStR has no generation field, Destatis publishes only totals by energy source, SMARD/ENTSO-E stop at 100 MW.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -s 'https://www.smard.de/app/chart_data/970/Amprion/970_Amprion_year_1735686000000.json'  # productionId 970 = Niederaußem K, region = plant regionId from https://www.smard.de/app/power_plant_data/power_plant_metadata.json
steps: Download power_plant_metadata.json (about 1 MB): 596 sites, 1,956 blocks; resolve KW-* keys with lang-de.json.
Flatten to one row per block carrying the site coordinates, address, operator and regionId; filter by status key and resource.
For a block with productionId P at a site with regionId R, read /app/chart_data/P/R/index_year.json (or index_month, index_hour) to list period starts T.
Read /app/chart_data/P/R/P_R_year_T.json; the value is the net generation of that unit for the year.
reading_traps: Coordinates are per site, not per block: all blocks of a site share one point.
13 sites are outside Germany (7 with Austrian coordinates); filter country 'KW-Land.Deutschland'.
Status keys mix 'KW-Status.In Betrieb' (1,761 blocks) and 'KW-Status.in Betrieb' (2); normalise case.
Metadata lag the latest Kraftwerksliste; compare by MaStR number before counting.
Only 212 blocks have a productionId; the chart_data path needs the TSO regionId (DE or DE-LU return 404).
Unit series agree with Energy-Charts within 0.5% (Boxberg Q 2025: 5189233.25 vs 5.192 TWh; Datteln 4: 3441122.2 vs 3.425 TWh).

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o Kraftwerksliste.xlsx 'https://www.bundesnetzagentur.de/DE/Fachthemen/ElektrizitaetundGas/Versorgungssicherheit/Erzeugungskapazitaeten/Kraftwerksliste/_DL/Kraftwerksliste.xlsx?__blob=publicationFile&v=18'  # sheet 'Gesamtkraftwerksliste', header in row 6, data from row 7
how_to_use.example_result: SEE983252937631 | RWE Power AG | Niederaußem K | NordrheinWestfalen | Deutschland | 2003 | (none) | InBetrieb | Braunkohle | Rohbraunkohlen | KWK Ja | 998 MW gross | 944 MW net | KondensationsmaschinemitEntnahme | Hoechstspannung | Amprion GmbH
steps: Read sheet 'Gesamtkraftwerksliste'; rows 1-5 are titles and notes, row 6 is the header (20 columns); 3,113 data rows as of 2026-11-05.
Drop aggregated rows (EinheitMastrNummer empty; 441 rows for < 10 MW sites, wind and PV).

Keep thermal and nuclear energy sources: Braunkohle, Steinkohle, Erdgas, Kernenergie, Mineraloelprodukte, Abfall, Grubengas, Wasserstoff, Waerme, Sonstige Energietraeger (nicht erneuerbar) and the thermal renewables Biomasse/Geothermie if wanted (1,965 named rows including them; 193 operating Biomasse units).

Filter Kraftwerksstatus: 'InBetrieb' gives 1,488 thermal/nuclear units (57,399 MW net); keep reserve states separate (Netzreserve, Kapazitätsreserve, besonderes netztechnisches Betriebsmittel, § 50 KVBG) and exclude 'endgültig stillgelegt ...'.
Join EinheitMastrNummer to MaStR (municipality/PLZ) or SMARD metadata (site coordinates) for location.
For units under construction or announced closures to 2030 use ZuUndRueckbau.xlsx (sheet 'Zu- und Rückbau einzeln', MaStR-Nr., operator, net MW, expected year; Datenstand 05.11.2026).
reading_traps: No coordinates, postcode or municipality: location is only Bundesland; earlier editions of the list had more location fields, so old scripts may expect columns that no longer exist.
The 10 MW threshold is per site, not per unit: 1,372 listed units are themselves below 10 MW.
Units closed on 31 December appear as 'endgültig stillgelegt' only in the following year's evaluation (note in row 5).
All 9 nuclear rows are 'endgültig stillgelegt' (last closures 2023); there is no operating nuclear unit to filter.
The CSV is Windows-1252 with decimal comma; reading it as UTF-8 breaks umlauts.
Rows from Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg and Denmark (62 rows) are included; filter Land = 'Deutschland'.
Status 'InBetrieb' in the Kraftwerksliste and 'In Betrieb' in MaStR differ: MaStR has only four states and reports reserve units (e.g. Jänschwalde A) as 'In Betrieb'.

evidence.claim: Data are taken from MaStR as of 2026-11-05.
Closures on 31 December count in the following year.
evidence.quote: Anlagen die zum 31.12. stillgelegt wurden, werden hier in dem darauffolgenden Jahr als endgültig stillgelegt ausgewertet

steps: For a full table, download the Stichtag export (about 3.2 GB ZIP) from the download page; the daily file name changes every day.
Use EinheitenVerbrennung.xml (fossil, waste, gases), EinheitenKernkraft.xml (nuclear), EinheitenBiomasse.xml and EinheitenGeothermieGrubengasDruckentspannung.xml; files are UTF-16 XML.
Resolve catalogue ids (status, energy source, fuel, technology, Land) with Katalogwerte.xml.
Divide kW by 1,000 for MW; filter EinheitBetriebsstatus and the reserve flags.

For quick filtered lists use the public overview JSON (energy source codes: Braunkohle 2408, Steinkohle 2407, Erdgas 2410, Mineralölprodukte 2409, Kernenergie 2494, nicht biogener Abfall 2412; status 35 In Betrieb).
reading_traps: In the 2026-10-01 export all 872 combustion units with net >= 10 MW lack coordinates, Gemeinde and PLZ (only Landkreis); 24,103 of 94,203 combustion units have coordinates, nearly all between 30 kW and 10 MW.
The documentation example swaps axes (Laengengrad 51.254, Breitengrad 12.597); in the data Breitengrad is latitude (e.g. Grohnde 52.0352).
MaStR has only four operating states, so reserve and KVBG-phase-out units appear as 'In Betrieb'.
Capacities are in kW, unlike the Kraftwerksliste (MW).
The reduced overview JSON (GetVerkleinerte...) has no location fields; use GetErweiterte... for Bundesland, Landkreis and StandortAnonymisiert.
The download portal warns of bandwidth limits and permanent IP blocks for abusive use.

steps: Register on the Transparency Platform and obtain a security token for the RESTful API.
Query documentType=A73, processType=A16 for the German bidding zone or control area, one day or up to the allowed period per request.
Sum MW x interval length per registeredResource over the calendar year to get MWh per unit.
reading_traps: Values are average net MW per interval, not MWh: multiply by the interval length (15 or 60 minutes) before summing.
Only units >= 100 MW: most CHP and industrial units are missing.
The old static help pages (FAQ, API guide, knowledge base) now return HTTP 400 on the new platform.
